autovalley.title: Auto Valley · Farm assistant
autovalley.modules.hint: F8 start / pause · Ctrl+F8 settings · Pause emergency stop
autovalley.schedule.hint: Game-day schedule; actual ripe / ready state is still checked.
autovalley.schedule.ready_hint: Clear saved dates after manual work or changing facilities.
autovalley.schedule.dates: Current game day: %s · Earliest next work day: %s
autovalley.schedule.cleared: Saved due dates cleared. Block readiness will be checked when you resume.
autovalley.error.schedule: Enter whole game days from 1 to 28 for each cycle.
autovalley.error.registered: This location or double chest is already registered. Edit it on the Locations tab.
autovalley.scan.hint: Scan loaded blocks nearby, then select a candidate.
autovalley.scan.done: %s candidates found. Select and confirm each location.
autovalley.label: Location name
autovalley.classifier.grade: Tomato grade: 0 normal · 1 iron · 2 gold · 3 diamond
autovalley.classifier.year: Wine production Year (integer; not current age)
autovalley.container.hint: Open this container yourself first and confirm its contents and classification.
autovalley.farms.hint: Include both vine heights. Each field: at most 32,768 blocks.
autovalley.farms.reopen_hint: Close, aim at a vine, reopen Ctrl+F8, then capture the next corner.
autovalley.farms.replace_hint: Select a registered field to edit its bounds or name.
autovalley.farms.corners_hint: Aim at tomato vines at opposite corners and heights.
autovalley.farms.corner_captured: Corner captured. Close settings to aim at the other corner.
autovalley.farms.clear_draft: Clear draft and begin a new field
autovalley.farms.suggestions_hint: Suggestions only. Check bounds; nearby fields can merge.
autovalley.farms.no_suggestions: No tomato vines found in the loaded scan area.
autovalley.disposal.capture: Face discard target; save position + direction
autovalley.disposal.facing_saved: Discard direction updated. The standing position is unchanged.
autovalley.disposal.edit_hint: Stand at this point and face the discard target. Click to save the new direction.
autovalley.error.disposal_facing: Return to this discard point, face the discard target, then select its saved row to update the direction.
autovalley.waypoint.hint: Record points every 5 blocks, including stairs and turns.
autovalley.saved.empty: No locations registered. Use the Register tab to begin.
autovalley.saved.feet_hint: To move a standing point, remove it and register your new position.
autovalley.error.save: Could not save the local profile. Changes were rolled back; check local file permissions.
autovalley.error.target: Aim at a tomato vine, supported machine, container, or bed before opening settings.
autovalley.error.classifier: Enter a grade from 0 to 3, or a non-negative integer production Year for wine.
autovalley.error.container_unchecked: Open and inspect the container yourself, then confirm that its contents match.
autovalley.error.changed: The selected block changed or is no longer loaded. Approach it and scan again.
autovalley.error.tomato_target: Close settings and aim directly at a tomato vine, then reopen settings.
autovalley.error.farm_bounds: Capture two corners. The inclusive box must contain at most 32,768 blocks.
autovalley.error.label: Enter a field name.
autovalley.error.label_used: Another field has this name. Choose a different name or select that field to edit it.
autovalley.error.farm_limit: Two fields are already registered. Edit an existing field or remove it first.
autovalley.error.farm_overlap: These bounds overlap another registered field. Adjust the corners.
autovalley.error.unloaded: This location is outside loaded chunks. Move closer before editing.
autovalley.error.ground: Stand still on a safe solid surface before registering a standing point.
autovalley.error.duplicate: A location is already registered at your feet. Remove it first to change its purpose.
autovalley.error.scan: The nearby scan failed. Check that the world is loaded and try again.
autovalley.error.hoe: Hold a usable hoe in your hotbar, then select Use held hoe.
